# Convert JPG to PNG

- Route: `/tools/convert-jpg-to-png`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `image`
- Slug: `convert-jpg-to-png`

## Summary

Turn JPG photos into lossless PNG files ready for editing, transparency, and high-quality graphics work. (Image tools)

## Details

PNG is a lossless format that never adds compression artifacts, which makes it ideal once you start editing an image, adding transparency, or layering graphics. Converting a JPG to PNG locks in the current pixels so further edits don’t degrade quality. Media Manipulator converts your JPG to a clean PNG online, free, with no signup.
### What it does
- Converts any .jpg/.jpeg image to a lossless .png file.
- Preserves the exact current pixels so repeated editing won’t add artifacts.
- Produces a PNG you can later layer, mask, or make transparent in an editor.
- Every pixel of the JPG is kept exactly; the PNG stores them without further loss.
### How to use it
1. Upload JPG: Drop in a .jpg or .jpeg photo.
2. Convert to PNG: We re-encode the image losslessly as PNG.
3. Encode PNG: ImageMagick writes a standard 24/32-bit PNG.
4. Download PNG: Save a lossless .png ready for editing.
### Supported formats
- Input: jpg, jpeg
- Output: png
- PNG is lossless, so the output is usually larger than the source JPG.
### Technical details
- PNG is lossless, so the converted file will usually be larger than the source JPG — that is expected.
- Converting JPG to PNG does not recover detail the JPG already discarded; it freezes the current pixels losslessly.
- PNG supports an alpha channel, so the result is ready for you to add transparency in an editor.
- For the smallest lossless web files, WebP (lossless) is often smaller than PNG.
### Use cases
- Editing prep: Convert a JPG to PNG before retouching so edits stay lossless.
- Adding transparency: Get a PNG canvas ready to cut out a background.
- UI and app assets: Most design systems expect PNG for icons and graphics.
- Document embedding: Use PNG where crisp text and lines matter more than file size.
### FAQ
Q: How do I convert a JPG to PNG for free?
A: Upload your .jpg above and click convert — the output is a lossless .png. It is free, requires no signup, and works in your browser.
Q: Does converting JPG to PNG improve quality?
A: No. The conversion is lossless but it cannot recover detail the JPG already discarded. It freezes the current pixels so future edits stay artifact-free.
Q: Will the PNG be bigger than my JPG?
A: Usually yes. PNG stores every pixel exactly with no lossy compression, so a photographic PNG is typically larger than the equivalent JPG.
Q: Can I add transparency after converting to PNG?
A: Yes. PNG supports an alpha channel, so once you have the PNG you can erase or cut out a background in any image editor.
